item.title: Gaming Technician
item.description: As a Gaming Technician, you’ll be responsible for the installation, maintenance, and servicing of gaming equipment, ensuring optimal performance and a seamless experience for our guests.
item.ns1:description:
Join The Star Gold Coast as a Gaming Technician, where you will play a key role in keeping our vibrant gaming floor running at its best. In this hands-on position, you’ll be responsible for the installation, maintenance, and servicing of gaming equipment, ensuring optimal performance and a seamless experience for our guests. You’ll uphold all statutory and regulatory requirements while delivering high-quality technical support across a diverse range of gaming equipment.

The Star Gold Coast has been the heart of the Gold Coast to live, work and play for over 40 years. As a premier destination for entertainment with award-winning restaurants, lively bars, theatrical experiences, casino gaming, stunning event spaces, and over 1,000 rooms, suites and apartments, it offers something for every guest.

Whether you're ready to embrace a new challenge or step into your next chapter, this is the place to make it happen.

What we can offer you

  • Complimentary meal on site every day including hot meals, sandwich bar and more
  • Uniform laundered and ready for you daily on property
  • Competitive hourly rate, plus penalty rates for nights, weekends and public holidays
  • Discounted parking available
  • Up to 30% discounts across award our winning restaurants and accommodation
  • An organisation that values diversity, teamwork and being your best self
  • Lifestyle discounts including gym memberships, retail discounts and dry-cleaning services
  • Five weeks of paid Annual Leave for team members who meet the definition of shift worker

What we are looking for

  • Trade certificate or Cert 3 in electronic (essential)
  • Previous experience operating and maintaining gaming equipment/systems
  • Skilled in the use of electronic test equipment (relating to electronic gaming machines)
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills as you work with a diverse team
  • Currently hold, or ability to obtain a Queensland Key Employee (KE) Casino Licence (which includes thorough background checks)
  • Flexible availability to work across a 24-hour/7-day roster

Our culture

At The Star, we are committed to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace that we know will contribute to exceptional experiences for our guests, a great place to work for our team members and positive outcomes for our communities. We welcome applications from all cultures, ages, religions, genders, LGBTQI+ community, Australia’s First Nations Peoples, and people with disabilities. Veterans are also encouraged to apply.

It’s your time to SHINE!
